text_block_list.text:
Super Creek was the one who conquered the 
Kikuka-sho. Faced with that sheer power, 
joy welled up inside Mejiro Ardan even 
before any feelings of frustration.

There are still countless rivals she wants 
to surpass, and the battles against them 
will surely be contests to which she can 
devote her entire heart and soul—

Realizing that she can grow boundlessly as 
long as rivals exist, Mejiro Ardan feels 
her heart leap toward her next goal.

At the same time, Sakura Chiyono O was 
watching the Kikuka Sho on TV, witnessing 
Mejiro Ardan's growth firsthand.

Mejiro Ardan steps forward toward the 
Osaka Hai. However, she has no way of 
knowing about the shadow that fell across 
Sakura Chiyono O's face...
